shared_elements: rows of repeated small figures/strokes arranged horizontally
human figures shown schematically in a line
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry rows of small repeated schematic marks read as human figures or crew — in A a register of standing figures under a rayed disc above dense columns of script signs, in B a line of vertical stroke-figures set inside a long upturned-prowed boat hull. The subject matter otherwise diverges completely: A shows an offering/adoration scene with a solar disc, figures with raised arms and extensive writing, while B shows profile ships with no writing, no disc and no narrative scene.
